description.value: Royal Paan is a Canadian franchise of Mumbai-style Indian street food, founded in 2001 and now operating 48+ locations across North America. The Burnaby location serves a fully vegetarian menu spanning traditional chaat, paan, falooda, kulfi, and innovative fusion items like the Noodle Burger. It is a lively, popular spot known for bold flavours and a wide variety of South Asian street-food classics made to order.
